name: research_lane_triage_lq1659_20261109
comment: ANCHOR: LQ-20261107-1659 — three alarms on /v3/health were triaged, and each test pins one verdict.
drive-sync: DEGRADED_STALE_SOURCE now means the synced pin does not CONTAIN origin/main (git
merge-base --is-ancestor); the host promotes an integration fold, so the live pin is normally AHEAD
of main and the old equality test fired on every normal deploy. Only git's 1 ('not an ancestor')
is a verdict; an unreadable repository is not evidence. The decision has one implementation
(drive_sync_health.source_status_for) that both the writer and the health reader use.
overnight-deep: the lane writes no row when its provider refuses, so the alarm now carries the
provider prober's own verdict (kind/detail/consec_fail/quota_exhausted) and its hint names the
provider rather than the 2026-08 retarget; without a verdict it says what actually happens (no row
written, so the same targets repeat hourly) and points at the unit journal.
coverage-stall: a flat thesis count is not charged to thesis minting while the deepseek research
leg is measurably down (error_rate_24h over the shared threshold with enough attempts); the row is
held ok and held_by says why, because deepseek's own lane carries that alarm. A healthy leg with a
flat thesis still fires, and a caller that passes no research row keeps the previous behaviour.
Fixtures are synthetic (temp git repos, loopback URLs, no live symbols or addresses).
